capabilities.title: AI Capability Preview
capabilities.hint: Click any capability to explore what it does and how it will work.

adaptiveDifficulty.title: Adaptive difficulty
adaptiveDifficulty.tagline: Controls how easy or challenging generated quiz questions should be.
adaptiveDifficulty.whatItIs: Controls how easy or challenging the generated quiz questions are.
adaptiveDifficulty.purpose: Helps teachers match quiz difficulty to student readiness.
adaptiveDifficulty.howToUse: Choose Easy, Medium, or Challenging before generating the quiz.

curriculumTagging.title: Curriculum tagging engine
curriculumTagging.tagline: Maps each question to district standards — NGSS, Common Core, TEKS, and custom frameworks.
curriculumTagging.whatItIs: Maps questions to standards and curriculum frameworks.
curriculumTagging.purpose: Reduces manual alignment overhead for teachers.
curriculumTagging.howToUse: This capability is currently hidden from the MVP interface.

playlistAnalytics.title: Student playlist analytics
playlistAnalytics.tagline: Track mastery by clip, regroup learners, and export insight dashboards.
playlistAnalytics.whatItIs: Tracks mastery patterns across playlist content.
playlistAnalytics.purpose: Helps teachers identify struggling students and segments.
playlistAnalytics.howToUse: This capability is currently hidden from the MVP interface.

accessibility.title: Accessibility assistant
accessibility.tagline: Simplifies question wording so quizzes are easier to read.
accessibility.whatItIs: Simplifies question wording for easier reading.
accessibility.purpose: Makes quizzes clearer for students who need accessible language.
accessibility.howToUse: Turn Accessibility Mode ON before generating the quiz.

lessonPlan.title: Auto-generated lesson plan
lessonPlan.tagline: Converts your quiz into a full 60-minute lesson plan with warm-up, activities, and closure.
lessonPlan.whatItIs: Builds complete lesson plans from generated quizzes.
lessonPlan.howToUse: This capability is currently hidden from the MVP interface.

worksheetFromQuiz.title: Worksheet from quiz
worksheetFromQuiz.tagline: Converts a generated quiz into a printable worksheet and answer key.
worksheetFromQuiz.whatItIs: Converts the generated quiz into a printable student worksheet.
worksheetFromQuiz.purpose: Lets teachers use the quiz offline or in class.
worksheetFromQuiz.howToUse: Generate the quiz first, then click Generate Worksheet/export.

classroomFlow.title: How to Use This Quiz in Class
classroomFlow.hint: Click each step to see what you do, what the system prepares, and what's coming next.

chooseVideo.title: Choose or paste video
chooseVideo.whatTeacher: Paste a YouTube link or select from Quick Start sources below.
chooseVideo.whatSystem: Validates URL, fetches video metadata, and confirms transcript availability.
chooseVideo.backendReq: YouTube Data API v3 + transcript extraction service.

generateQuiz.title: Generate quiz blueprint
generateQuiz.whatTeacher: Set grade band, subject lens, and question styles — then click Generate.
generateQuiz.whatSystem: Runs AI pipeline: transcript segmentation → DOK alignment → question generation.
generateQuiz.backendReq: LLM inference endpoint (already live). Transcript extraction API.

reviewQuestions.title: Review questions
reviewQuestions.whatTeacher: Preview generated questions, edit or remove items, and reorder sections.
reviewQuestions.whatSystem: Renders structured quiz preview with answer keys and difficulty tags.

selectStrategy.title: Select teaching strategy
selectStrategy.whatTeacher: Choose a lesson flow strategy. Preview configuration and apply to quiz.
selectStrategy.whatSystem: Stores strategy preference against the quiz session for export customisation.
selectStrategy.backendReq: Quiz strategy save endpoint + teacher session storage.

export.title: Export, print, or save
export.whatTeacher: Download as PDF, copy to Google Forms, or generate a shareable link.
export.whatSystem: Formats quiz into the selected template. Generates share token or file blob.
export.backendReq: PDF renderer, Google Forms API integration, link shortener service.

reuse.title: Reuse for future lessons
reuse.whatTeacher: Save to quiz library. Tag by topic. Search and clone for new classes.
reuse.whatSystem: Persists quiz to teacher library with tagging, versioning, and class assignment.
reuse.backendReq: Quiz library CRUD, tag index, class roster linking.
